description: Used to claim a partial advance from EPF balance for specific purposes: medical emergency, marriage, education, house purchase, home loan repayment, or natural calamity.

fields.name: UAN Number
fields.description: Your 12-digit Universal Account Number. Must be active and KYC-linked on the EPFO portal.

fields.name: Member Name
fields.description: Full name as per EPFO records or Aadhaar card — do not abbreviate.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Father's name (if unmarried) or husband's name (if married), as per Aadhaar.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format — must match UAN profile.

fields.name: Name & Address of Factory / Establishment
fields.description: Full name and address of your current employer.

fields.name: Purpose of Advance
fields.description: Select the applicable purpose: 1-Medical, 2-Marriage (self/sibling/child), 3-Education, 4-Housing loan repayment, 5-House purchase/construction, 6-Natural calamity.

fields.name: Amount Required (in Rs.)
fields.description: The advance amount you need. Cannot exceed 6 times monthly wages (for housing) or specific caps per purpose.

fields.name: Total PF Balance
fields.description: Auto-filled or mentioned based on your passbook balance from the EPFO portal.

fields.name: Number of Years of Service
fields.description: Total years of continuous service — eligibility for most withdrawals requires 5-7 years.

fields.name: Bank Account Number
fields.description: Your bank account number linked with UAN on EPFO portal.

fields.name: IFSC Code
fields.description: IFSC code of the bank branch for transfer.

fields.name: Mode of Payment
fields.description: ECS (NEFT) is the standard digital transfer mode.

fields.name: Supporting Documents (mention)
fields.description: List the documents you are attaching: Doctor's certificate (medical), Marriage invitation (marriage), Admission letter (education), etc.

fields.name: Employee Signature with Date
fields.description: Your full signature and date confirming the accuracy and intent of this advance claim.

fields.name: Employer Certification
fields.description: Employer certifies the employee's service duration, salary, and purpose eligibility.
